A '''skirmish''' on [[Paklan]] involved the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] battling several bounty hunters at a diner.

==Prelude==
After the [[Skirmish on Pleem's Nexus|skirmish]] on [[Pleem's Nexus]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] traveled to the forest world of [[Paklan]]. They had attracted the attention of the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] businessman, [[Ja'Boag]]. Shortly before the skirmish, [[Zika]] had tracked Maul and Opress to a diner on Paklan. Zika met with [[Toomey]] and told him that they were hiding out in a diner. They met up with a band of bounty hunters outside the diner, and began to send in the hunters to claim the price on their heads.

==The Skirmish==
{{Quote|Drop any weapons and raise your hands|Toomey to Darth Maul and Savage Opress inside his Diner|<ref name="Darth Maul—Death Sentence 1">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]]</ref>}}
After meeting with the band of bounty hunters outside the diner, [[Toomey]] decided to send in a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] hunter so that he may help negotiate their surrenders. This was that the case, however, as [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] used [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] to throw him out and [[Telekinesis/Legends|strangle]] him, shortly after he walked in. [[Zika]] stated this was more than enough proof that Maul and his [[Savage Opress/Legends|brother]] were inside the diner, and took his payment and ran off.

Toomey and the other hunters decided to walk in, and they demanded that Maul and Savage drop their weapons and surrender. Maul then commanded Savage to deal with the hunters. Both Maul and Savage dealt with them very easily.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Who is this Ja'Boag?|Darth Maul interrogating Toomey inside his Diner|<ref name="Darth Maul—Death Sentence 1" />}}
Once Maul and Savage had Killed all of the bounty hunters, only Toomey remained. They questioned him, violently, and discovered that [[Ja'Boag]], who was the head of [[Rim Commercial Mining]] had placed a price on their heads for unknown reasons. They also learned that Ja'Boag was also in charge of mining operations on [[Moorjhone]], and that he would be there.

==Appearances==
*[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]] {{1st}}
